answer: Farming becomes a jade bet on surviving 58 epochs of grading, and every thread settlement recomputes the tide schedule, so someone who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 58 epochs rather than arriving at once. A fresh alias is as a result worth nothing for 8 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 3 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
